newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch temporary employment growth slows.
newsitem.headline: Dutch temporary employment growth slows.

text.p: The spectacular growth in the services provided by Dutch temporary employment agencies seems to be slowing, the Central Bureau of Statistics said on Monday.
The CBS said staff hired through temporary agencies in the third quarter worked a total of 86 million hours in the third quarter of 1996, a rise of 18.5 percent compared with the same period of 1995.
The second and first quarters of 1996 showed rises of 24.5 and 25.8 percent respectively, compared with the corresponding periods of 1995.

The seasonally adjusted number of hours worked in the third quarter of 1996 fell to 74 million hours (equivalent to 144,000 full-time jobs) from 76 million hours (equivalent to 146,000 full-time jobs) in the second quarter of 1996, the CBS said.
Temporary employment agencies listed on the Amsterdam stock exchange are Randstad Holding, Content Beheer and Vendex through its Vedior subsidiary.
